reviews.review:
Get it on sale, grind out some cards, enjoy a relaxing zombie murder sim with some crazy perks.
Multiplayer is mostly dead without crossplay, can still get full matches occasionally.
My biggest gripe with this game is the pacing, it's locked most of the game behind DLC, which is a shame because the game FEELS GOOD to play, it just sucks that it takes forever to get there, load times between maps are way to long with a minute and 30 second wait time for all members to ready up before it forces us forward. (I feel this has to do with console load times more than anything)

Don't get me started on burn cards being in the skull totem tree, enjoy the hives as mini maps and a challenge, if you don't get max skulls, don't worry, you'll want about 36 in your inventory to snag skins as the rotate and you see one you like, after that, it's just extra. Don't waste income on burn cards, you're never gunna use them without a 4 man trying the hardest difficulties.

tl;dr: Fun game, implimented poorly, somewhat paywalled, 5/10, coulda been great, someone should rip the assets and make a l4d3
Hopes everyone can find some good teammates without sabotaging

I still play after 600+ hours but I have a special place for L4D and B4B filled that void well. The card system mixes things up pretty well so that even the most OP melee build can be reduced to using firearms when everything explodes at close range. The banter between characters is goofy and creates funny things to quote later throughout the game. This builds the personalities of each character mostly for the better. I'm sad to hear they don't plan on adding more content but hopefully the developers will open up the game to the modding community now that they are done with their rollout plan. +1 vote for modding options and fan created content.

If you don't look at it as a true Left 4 Dead successor, then it's a pretty fun game to kill time with. Gunplay felt pretty good and the zombies had good variety. Other than that there isn't much replayability, but if you grab it on sale then it's worth a try.

Not nearly as bad as some would suggest.
Though it adds needless complexity compared to L4D, it is still a fun experience with good shooting, a good sense of flow, and satisfying mid-campaign progression with attachments. The level design and set pieces of the DLC are particular highlights for me. I also like how the special infected rely much less on grapple attacks compared to L4D.
